text: At 65', Seabrook Town triggered a pressing overhaul to chase the 2-1 deficit by increasing their PPDA from 6.7 to 0.84, pushing their defensive line height from 0.6 to 0.72, and raising passing directness from 0.42 to 0.57, aiming to disrupt Harbour City’s patient 4-2-3-1 buildup earlier and transition quickly into attack [#1361]. This pressing trigger led to a decrease in Seabrook’s xG from 0.78 to 0.46 despite similar possession (~54%), reflecting reduced shot quality under higher pressure. Field tilt dropped from 70% to 48%, indicating Harbour City’s success in resisting this overload and transition mechanism defensively. Harbour City’s slightly increased opponent xG (0.03 to 0.14) implies some vulnerability in rest-defense but no significant breakthroughs, confirming that Seabrook’s higher line and directness led to more turnovers and less efficient chance creation [#1361].
